security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; frame-src https://embed.figma.com https://www.figma.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first notes that sync through your own cloud folder
bundle.longDescription: MyNote keeps your notes as plain Markdown files in a folder you choose — iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or just this computer — with full-text and semantic search, backlinks, a graph, canvases and an MCP server for Claude Code and Codex. Everything runs locally.
